messages.subject: subdivide large linkage groups
parts:
When I run

lod6 <- formLinkageGroups(disMarkers_q50C50, max.rf=0.35, min.lod=6)

I get 3 linkage groups: 899 156  33

I want to split the 899 markers on chr1 into 3 groups of 300 so that when I run

orderMarkers it is less computationally intensive and more tractable when I pull.map  as a table

thanks in advance for help, roberta

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] subdivide large linkage groups
parts:
I would split the marker names into three groups and then use movemarker().

mnames1 <- markernames(mycross, chr=1)
n.mark <- length(mnames1)
mnames1b <- mnames1[seq(2, n.mark, by=3)]
mnames1c <- mnames1[seq(3, n.mark, by=3)]
for(marker in mnames1b)
mycross <- movemarker(mycross, marker, "1b")
for(marker in mnames1c)
mycross <- movemarker(mycross, marker, "1c")

karl
